list.name: reason
list.description: Defaults to POLICY_DENIED, the verdict that this dashboard and PolicyDropsDetected are about. Switch to All to see every reason. Expect a constant floor of UNSUPPORTED_L3_PROTOCOL. The kernel gives every pod an IPv6 link-local address and solicits a router forever, with router_solicitations=-1. Cilium runs IPv4-only, so it drops them. Nothing is broken: that drop IS the IPv4-only enforcement.

panels.title: Dropped flows by reason
panels.description: Cilium policy verdicts, kept for history and alerting. Hubble UI shows live drops, but it keeps no history. POLICY_DENIED here means that a NetworkPolicy blocks a flow that someone expected to work.

panels.title: Dropped flows by source and destination
panels.description: With sourceContext and destinationContext set to workload, the label is `<namespace>/<workload>`. So temporal-frontend and temporal-history stay separate, and do not collapse into one `temporal` series.

panels.title: Total drops by protocol
panels.description: A sudden spike of ICMP or TCP drops after a policy change is the sign of a default-deny regression. This repo has had them before.
